patch.value: Release merge-wait keeps a stale approval flag and misdiagnoses its own timeout

Tracks gh:unbraind/pm-linear#200 (filed 2026-11-01, missed by the blind issue watch). release.yml on current main still initializes awaiting_approval=0 outside the merge-wait loop (line ~451), sets it to 1 whenever pending_runs is nonempty (~578) and never resets it, so the timeout branch (~583) tells maintainers to approve a run that already succeeded or finished instead of reporting the actually settling checks (observed 2026-11-01: three runs approved at 15:18, timeout at 15:47 still claiming approval was awaited). Reset the flag per iteration (or test current approval state at timeout) and assert the timeout diagnostic names the real settling/failing checks.

## Observed defect
The release merge wait retains an old approval-required flag after approval succeeds. On timeout it therefore tells maintainers to approve a run that is already running or finished, hiding the actual settling checks.

Affected source: [release.yml at 133914ec3f7b39c00ae2434f138c004540d9e5a2, lines 450–586](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/133914ec3f7b39c00ae2434f138c004540d9e5a2/.github/workflows/release.yml#L450-L586).

## Hosted evidence and current status
[Release job 124878188416](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/41298011467/job/124878188416):
- 15:18:07–15:18:08 UTC, 2026-11-01: reports successful approval of runs 41320486523, 41320486470 and 41320486461.
- 15:47:44 UTC: merge API reports required `test (22)` still in progress; workflow lists `test (22), release-gate (npm)` settling, no failing checks.
- 15:47:45 UTC: timeout instead claims “its CI run is awaiting workflow approval” and directs a maintainer to approve it.

At 16:23 UTC, [release PR #199](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/pull/199) remains open at `1072b05f71f85479defb7a2ede9fdedb759c661d`; GitHub reports clean mergeability, and its check runs have completed successfully/neutral/skipped. The three previously approved workflow runs now report success/skipped/success. This is not a claim that checks are still failing, nor a request to bypass protection or manually merge.

## Cause and bounded reproduction
`awaiting_approval=0` is initialized outside the loop (line451), set to1 whenever `pending_runs` is nonempty (line578), and never reset. The timeout tests that historical flag (line583) instead of current approval state.
A local Bash fixture preserving these assignment/conditional statements, substituting a no-op for approval calls, and feeding `pending_runs=41320486461` followed by empty `pending_runs`, reproduces the incorrect approval timeout. No network calls, merges, approvals, or full release workflow were executed.

## Intended guarantee and impact
The existing [pm-linear-niyz record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/133914ec3f7b39c00ae2434f138c004540d9e5a2/.agents/pm/issues/pm-linear-niyz.toon) explicitly separates awaiting approval from failed checks in deadline diagnostics; [PR #65](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/pull/65) delivered that work. This is a follow-up diagnostic defect, not a repetition of its merge-state deadlock.
An inaccurate instruction misdirects release recovery after the bounded wait expires. No publication/tag safety failure is established.

## Acceptance / regression criteria
- Derive timeout approval diagnosis from current successfully fetched state, not “ever observed approval required.”
- Approval pending → successfully approved/running → timeout must name remaining settling checks, not request approval.
- Still awaiting approval at timeout must retain the actual pending-run link; API lookup failure must be reported as unknown, not silently “no pending approval.”
- Preserve protected-merge authority, exact-head checks, and no-publish/no-tag behavior on failure; do not relax approval policy, coverage, or increase timeouts merely to hide the diagnostic.
- Test the state transition behavior with mocked responses, including persistent pending, cleared pending, API failure, and successful merge.

## Scope / dedup
All 199 current all-status issues/PR records were checked. No standalone issue covers this diagnostic. Related closed PR65 and canonical pm-linear-niyz were inspected. This is hosted evidence plus a bounded classifier reproduction, not whole-project or release certification.
fix(release): clear stale approval state before merge-wait timeout diagnosis
